mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a monetary policy tightening response from the Fed and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but FEDFUNDS does not rise by >25bp in the next 3 months, or SPX 20-day returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops by >2% m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time, or GDPC1 y-o-y growth does not slow by >1pp in the next 2 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by >10% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative >40% of the time, or RSAFS does not also rise by >5% y-o-y in the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises by >0.5pp m-o-m but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time, or PAYEMS does not also decline by >100k jobs in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3%, it signals an overheating economy that will prompt the Fed to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% but FEDFUNDS does not rise by >25bp in the next 3 months, or SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in the unemployment rate.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines by >5% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time, or UNRATE does not also rise by >0.5pp y-o-y in the next 2 months.
